title: Coffee Syrup
subtitle: A cardamom-scented coffee decoction syrup — the base for iced coffee, mocha, freakshakes and frappés.
protein: A syrup, not a protein source

method.title: Cook the syrup
items: In a saucepan, bring {@water}, {@sugar} and {@cardamom} to a boil, stirring until the sugar dissolves
Lower the heat; whisk in {@coffee} until there are no lumps
Simmer 3–4 min, until slightly syrupy — it thickens more as it cools

method.title: Cool and store
items: Pour into a clean glass bottle
Keeps about 2 weeks in the fridge; shake before using

method.label: Toddler note
items: This syrup is strong coffee — none for her
Each coffee drink recipe pours her a caffeine-free share before the syrup goes in

method.label: Tip
method.text: From Chef Ranveer Brar's cold coffee set. Use it in the iced coffee, iced mocha, coffee freakshake and frappuccino recipes. Caster sugar dissolves fastest; regular sugar works with an extra minute of stirring.
